propositions: Introduce a reducer-maintained plan_review_phase (planning|execution) derived from winning STATUS targets, carried through snapshot compaction and bootstrapped once from compiled status for pre-feature snapshots.
Restructure manifest to emit review-phase and, for execution, priority-floor 0.80 lines with a single grammar/policy helper that raises ManifestFormatError on malformed phase/floor tokens.

Add phase_status (compatible|incompatible|malformed) to plan-review health with a fixed non-configurable 0.80 execution blocking floor, enforced across claim, reuse, drift refresh, and re-sign but never by completion-verifier.

Thread review_phase through Pass-3 schemas, gate YAML decide branches, and gate_dispatch recovery so execution reviews floor only the float threshold when blocking is enabled and legacy absence defaults planning.
Persist review-time phase via an additive plan_review_result_v2 sidecar schema parsed by sidecar.parse_review_phase_metadata for failed-sign recovery, refusing incompatible or malformed re-sign.

Own a pre-sign generation transaction with an immutable pre-LLM baseline that retries only for unstable tracker HEAD, treats stable generation changes as terminal unsigned stale, and signs atomically under the write lock.
